correctness.rationale: The two half-period linear propagators multiply to H with eigenvalues 1,e^{±2 arcosh((1+cosh βh)/2)}, and Floquet exponent -γ+F(βh)/h. F(x)/x increases from 1/sqrt2 to 1, giving the unique h_c in the stated rate ratio interval. Strict positivity/subhomogeneity yield global endemic unique period orbit above threshold; periodic positive adjoint provides strict Lyapunov extinction at criticality. The Poincare stable-complement expansion r_{n+1}=r_n-q r_n²+o(r_n²) with q>0 proves all nonzero initial conditions share phase-dependent t^-1 profile. For β=1, γ=0.8, independently computed h_c=3.03490842766049 and q=1.924264168024 from direct two-stage variational integral and the elementary closed expression; agreement to 1.4e-15. These checks corroborate, do not prove, all-time convergence.

originality.rationale: Established temporal-network propagator threshold and switched-SIS stability are recognized background. Prasse–Van Mieghem full article treats static heterogeneous NIMFA near the threshold and expressly describes time-varying parameter extension as future work; its static near-threshold closed solution does not imply this phase-resolved, globally attracting critical amplitude under alternating contacts. No earlier published Resultary theorem supplied the identical q coefficient for this exact model; residual generic parabolic Floquet normal-form risk acknowledged.
residual_risks: A general parabolic Floquet asymptotic theorem might give t^-1 shape and coefficient by immediate specialization, limiting novelty.
